Audio channel layout as a bitmask.

Matches Symphonia's `Channels` type. Bits follow the WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE
standard (channels 0-17) plus Symphonia extensions (18+).

Common layouts:
* `0x1` = Mono (Front Center)
* `0x3` = Stereo (Front Left + Front Right)
* `0x3F` = 5.1 Surround
* `0xFF` = 7.1 Surround

Use `count_ones()` to get the number of channels from the bitmask.
